Offline, the preserved server loads a supplied-prospect copy (2,744 recorders); with no player it returns to lobby after idle timer and saves 2,741: both C033 tree recorders end recording on restore, one C031 voxel recorder goes, others keep counts

Reloading that output in a fresh run reads and saves 2,741 recorders, class counts unchanged; Accolades.json is rewritten identically; native inspector frames all 3 prospects' recorders (2,744, 2,741, 2,741) with no unknown fields, matching server counts

The 2 tree records the offline load dropped (F-678) were the save's only ones, both physics dynamic, each ending recording twice; respawn recreates the actor with saved flag, and actor code (F-736) ends the record

fields.claim: The prospect names no build: neither load input nor server output holds a version string/field, and the 3.0.30 server loaded it with no unknown-row or unknown-class warning, so a load cannot tell which build wrote it (refines F-635)

Each installation's Config/version.json gives its version: server 3.0.30 changelist 158174, client 3.0.31 changelist 158478 with newer backend-schema and data changelists; neither executable holds these strings. F-277 holds for installed client, not save

With no player the prospect clock nearly stops: 120 s in the loaded, empty world before lobby return advanced saved elapsed time by 14 s, so time-driven state is observable only with a connected player

A joined synthetic player lifts empty-world pause (logs OnServerLeaveEmpty): saved elapsed time rose 488 s vs 14 s in no-player control, the 32 growing crop plots' growth times rose 478-488 s vs 10-11 s, deployables changed, and it saved 475 s after join
